title: Machine memory
notes: Keep one adult at each table to read cards or scribe while children choose rows and arrows. For a return visit, K-1 can construct the last-blue or no-red machine (P4-5), then test shared continuations (P6). Grades 2-3 can connect P4 to the group-of-three machine (P5), or explore the last-RB machine (P6). Grades 4-5 can choose the state lower-bound route (P3-4 and P6) or suffix memory (P5). Save each proposed machine with its arrows so it can be challenged again; no redesign of the topic is needed.
